method: Read rendered official pages through browser DOM. Factual summary only.

cards.geometry: 12dp corners,16dp side content inset,8dp maximum between-card gap,start-aligned text
cards.semantics: Whole-card actions use button/link semantics; passive cards expose separate actions. Do not nest actionable controls in an actionable card.
cards.behavior: Ripple for pointer and keyboard activation; passive cards have no hover/ripple. Optional dragging/swiping needs a single-pointer alternative.
cards.mobile: Avoid internal scrolling; desktop internal scrolling allowed.

divider.tokens: 1dp outline-variant; full width or logical16dp start/both insets
divider.layout: Separate groups; prefer whitespace over excessive lines. No universal vertical height given.
divider.accessibility: Decorative; no contrast minimum. Upstream separator role retained, nonfocusable.
